stemMd: Which molecule can form hydrogen bonds with other molecules of the same substance through an O–H group?
explanationMd: Ethanol contains a hydroxyl group, supplying both a hydrogen-bond donor and an oxygen lone-pair acceptor. Having oxygen alone, as in an ether, does not provide an O–H donor.

distractorRationale.b: It has no O–H or N–H group.
distractorRationale.e: It has oxygen but no O–H donor in the pure substance.
distractorRationale.a: Its C–H bonds do not provide the stated O–H donor.
